from itertools import product

# Finite boolean model of the security office's plan.
# P_all: every non-returning student is financially hard-pressed (the plan targets the right group)
# C:     students are competent enough for the security work (the plan can relieve understaffing)
# F:     funds cover work-study pay for all who stay (the plan is affordable)
# T:     most non-returning students signed up for winter English tuition classes
names = ["P_all", "C", "F", "T"]
worlds = [dict(zip(names, v)) for v in product([False, True], repeat=len(names))]

# The plan's assumptions: all three must hold for the plan to achieve both goals.
def premises(w):
    return w["P_all"] and w["C"] and w["F"]

# Each option, read as a statement that is true in some world.
options = {
    "A": lambda w: not w["P_all"],  # not all non-returners are financially hard-pressed
    "B": lambda w: not w["C"],      # students are not competent for the security task
    "C": lambda w: not w["F"],      # funds are limited relative to the number of students
    "D": lambda w: w["T"],          # most non-returners signed up for tuition classes
}

# An option questions the plan iff it cannot be true while the plan's assumptions hold.
def questions_plan(opt):
    return not any(opt(w) and premises(w) for w in worlds)

print(f"Total worlds enumerated: {len(worlds)}")
print(f"Worlds satisfying plan premises: {sum(premises(w) for w in worlds)}")

non_questioning = []
for key, opt in options.items():
    consistent = sum(1 for w in worlds if opt(w) and premises(w))
    q = questions_plan(opt)
    print(f"Option {key}: worlds_consistent_with_premises={consistent} questions_plan={q}")
    if not q:
        non_questioning.append(key)

print(f"Options that cannot question the plan: {non_questioning}")

submitted = "D"
if non_questioning == [submitted]:
    print("CHECK PASS: submitted answer D is the only option that cannot question the plan.")
else:
    print(f"CHECK FAIL: submitted {submitted}, computed {non_questioning}.")

print("Note: this is an exhaustive check over a 4-variable abstraction of the question, not a full logical reading of the Chinese text.")
